title: Packr Travel Packing List
description:
Packr is a travel packing list app that helps you pack your suitcase for every trip ΓÇö so you never forget a thing. Save time before you go: your packing list is built automatically from your destination (city, country or region), travel dates and activities.

Γùå PACKING CHECKLIST Γùå

Packr creates a smart packing checklist for your suitcase from dozens of pre-defined activities.
Based on length of stay, weather and planned activities, your packing list is ready in no time. It's the perfect tool for summer vacations, long weekends, road trips, business travel and even camping.

Γùå LESS STRESS Γùå

Every journey is different, and each traveler has their own habits. Packr learns from each of your trips to organize the packing checklist, adjusting items based on your previous trips.
You will never forget to pack THAT thing again!

Γùå BETTER PREPARED Γùå

Set a quantity for each item ΓÇö some quantities adjust automatically to the length of your stay.
Create your own custom packing lists, and now use emojis as list icons to personalize them. Assign each item to a bag or suitcase, and filter your packing list by traveler.
Even your pets can have their own packing list.

Γùå PLAN MULTI-DESTINATION TRIPS Γùå

Import your trips directly from TripIt, including multi-destination itineraries, or convert any trip into a multi-destination journey.

Γùå PRACTICAL FEATURES Γùå

Sign in with your Apple account to securely save and sync your trips and packing lists across iPhone and iPad. Pack anywhere with improved offline mode ΓÇö even without a connection. You can also share your checklist with travel companions or print it out.


Packr has already travelled several thousand times around planet Earth, packing over a million items in each traveller's suitcase.

Packr has been used for trips to cities like Paris, London, Barcelona, New York City, Montreal, Berlin, Majorca... And countries like France, United Kingdom, Spain, Greece, USA, Italy, Canada, Germany and 1000+ more locations.

releaseNotes:
Packr gets a fresh new look ΓÇö plus Apple Sign-In, smarter packing lists, and better multi-destination trip planning.

Γùå New design Γùå

A refreshed, modern theme with a new Liquid Glass look across the whole app.

Sign in with your Apple account to securely save your trips and packing lists.

Γùå Packing lists & trips Γùå

- Improved weather forecast to include rain probability.
- Use emojis as your custom list icon ΓÇö over 3,700 new ways to personalise your lists.
- Filter packed and unpacked items when printing your packing list. (User requested)
- Import multi-destination trips from TripIt, and convert any trip into a multi-destination trip.
- Assign items to a bag or suitcase in both packing lists and default lists.
- Filter your packing list by traveler.
- Copy items to another list. (User requested)
- Add notes to default items and change their quantity. (User requested)
- Set up default reminders for items. (User requested)
- Set default lists for leisure and business trips. (User requested)

- Quick lists are now available in every language.
- Improved offline mode, so you can pack anywhere ΓÇö even without a connection.


Γùå Bug fixes & improvements Γùå

- Improved stability and fixed rare crashes, including an issue that could close the app on iPad.
- Improved multi-destination TripIt import.
